name: github-node
description: Interact with GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and code search.
long_description:
This MCP bundle connects Claude to the GitHub REST API, allowing you to browse repositories, read file contents, manage issues and pull requests, and search code — all using your personal access token.

Capabilities include:
- Listing and searching repositories
- Reading file and directory contents
- Listing branches and commits
- Creating and reading issues and issue comments
- Listing and reading pull requests
- Searching code across GitHub

tools.name: list_repositories
tools.description: List repositories for a user or organization

tools.name: get_repository
tools.description: Get details about a specific repository

tools.name: get_file_contents
tools.description: Read the contents of a file or list a directory in a repository

tools.name: list_commits
tools.description: List commits in a repository branch

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get details of a specific issue

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a repository

tools.name: create_issue_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an issue

tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.description: List pull requests in a repository

tools.name: get_pull_request
tools.description: Get details of a specific pull request

github_token.title: GitHub Personal Access Token
github_token.description: A GitHub personal access token (classic or fine-grained). Required for API access. Create one at https://github.com/settings/tokens

github_api_url.title: GitHub API URL
github_api_url.description: GitHub API base URL. Change this if you use GitHub Enterprise Server (e.g. https://github.example.com/api/v3).
